attacks.scenario: The generator applies the `[ExcludeFromCodeCoverage]` attribute to the `partial class` of the resolver. In C#, attributes applied to one part of a partial class apply to the entire class. Therefore, any user-written code in the other part of the partial class will also be excluded from code coverage.
attacks.test_sketch: Define a `partial class GeneratedMessagePackResolver` with a custom method. Run the generator to emit the other part of the partial class. Compile and check the custom method's coverage or inspect the class attributes via reflection; the entire class (including the user's custom method) will have the `ExcludeFromCodeCoverage` attribute.
